{{Quote|To the west is a giant bark mite cave. I can show you where. I need specimens. Once you get there, I'll transmit the specimens that I need and how many of each.|[[Risha Sinan]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BMS">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=general|Bark Mite Samples|Rori}}</ref>}}
[[File:GiantBarkMite.jpg|200px|thumb|A giant bark mite inside the cave]]
The '''Giant Bark Mite Cave''' was a natural cave on the [[Naboo/Legends|Nabooian]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]. It was populated by giant [[bark mite]]s. The creatures had discovered that the cave was damp and warm, making it a perfect nursery for their brood. Those bark mite could become very dangerous when protecting their lair.<ref name="SWG:GBMC" /> The scientist [[Risha Sinan]] discovered the cave and its giant bark mites after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWG:BMS" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a spacer entered the bunker, fought some giant bark mites and collected a [[CY-M sword]].<ref name="SWG:RMWMII">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Rare Melee Weapons Mark II}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Giant Bark Mite Cave was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:GBMC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Giant Bark Mite Cave was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 1 Notes: 13 August 03|Publish 1]]" update, released on [[August 3]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60888|text=Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave}}</ref>
